environment: Single owner: one person owns every repository worked on here. There are no pull requests and no other committers. Each ticket lands by a fast-forward push of its commits to main on the repository's own GitHub remote.
allow: Pushing to main is allowed when it is a fast-forward push of this session's own landing commits to the repository's own remote: that is how every ticket lands.
hard_deny: Never force-push to any branch: no --force, --force-with-lease, -f, or a refspec starting with +.
Never delete a remote branch: no git push --delete, no git push <remote> :<branch>, no API call that deletes a ref.
Never deploy to production, by any tool, script or CI trigger.
Never skip git hooks: no --no-verify, and no -n on git commit.
Never read ~/.ssh, ~/.aws, or a .env, .env.local, .env.*.local or .env.production file with a command that runs outside the sandbox. .env.example is fine.
Never edit ~/.claude/settings.json, the hook scripts in ~/.claude/scripts/, or the hook scripts a repository's .claude/settings.json runs.
